#1
अभयं|abhayam|a-bhaya — fearlessness (nom. sg. neut., first item of the list of divine qualities that runs through verse 3)
सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः|sattva-saṃśuddhiḥ jñāna-yoga-vyavasthitiḥ|sattva — being, one's own nature (first member);;saṃśuddhi — purification, purity (sattva-saṃśuddhi: 'purity of being', nom. sg. fem., list item; -iḥ+j-→-ir j-);;jñāna — knowledge (first member);;yoga — discipline, yoga, kept untranslated per convention (second member);;vyavasthiti — steadfastness, firm abiding (jñāna-yoga-vyavasthiti: 'steadfastness in the discipline of knowledge', nom. sg. fem., list item)
--
दानं|dānam|dāna — giving, charity (nom. sg. neut., list item)
दमश्च|damaḥ ca|dama — self-control, restraint of the senses (nom. sg. masc., list item; -aḥ+c-→-aś c-);;ca — and
यज्ञश्च|yajñaḥ ca|yajña — sacrifice (nom. sg. masc., list item; -aḥ+c-→-aś c-);;ca — and
स्वाध्यायस्तप|svādhyāyaḥ tapaḥ|sva-adhyāya — study of one's own [scripture], recitation of the Veda (nom. sg. masc., list item; -aḥ+t-→-as t-);;tapas — austerity (tapaḥ: nom. sg. neut., list item; its own visarga simply drops before the following ā- of ārjavam, with the hiatus retained rather than the vowels fusing to tapārjavam — an accepted option in epic verse, as at 15.16's akṣaraḥ eva)
आर्जवम्|ārjavam|ārjava — uprightness, straightforwardness (nom. sg. neut., list item)
#2
अहिंसा|ahiṃsā|a-hiṃsā — non-violence, non-injury (nom. sg. fem., list item)
सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः|satyam akrodhaḥ tyāgaḥ|satya — truthfulness (nom. sg. neut., list item; simply joined with akrodhaḥ, -m unaffected before the vowel);;a-krodha — freedom from anger (nom. sg. masc., list item; -aḥ+t-→-as t-);;tyāga — renunciation, relinquishment (nom. sg. masc., list item)
शान्तिरपैशुनम्|śāntiḥ apaiśunam|śānti — tranquility, peace (nom. sg. fem., list item; -iḥ+a-→-ir a-);;a-paiśuna — freedom from malice, freedom from backbiting (paiśuna, 'slander, calumny'; nom. sg. neut., list item)
--
दया|dayā|dayā — compassion (nom. sg. fem., list item; governs bhūteṣu, 'toward beings')
भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं|bhūteṣu aloluptvam|bhūta — a being, a creature (bhūteṣu: loc. pl., 'toward beings');;a-lolupa-tva — freedom from greed, freedom from craving (a-lolupa 'not greedy' + abstract suffix -tva; aloluptvam: nom. sg. neut., list item; -u+a-→-v a-, yaṇ sandhi)
मार्दवं|mārdavam|mārdava — gentleness, softness (nom. sg. neut., list item)
ह्रीरचापलम्|hrīḥ acāpalam|hrī — modesty, a sense of shame (hrīḥ: nom. sg. fem., list item; -īḥ+a-→-īr a-);;a-cāpala — freedom from fickleness, steadiness (nom. sg. neut., list item)
#3
तेजः|tejaḥ|tejas — vigor, fiery energy, brilliance (nom. sg. neut., list item)
क्षमा|kṣamā|kṣamā — patience, forbearance (nom. sg. fem., list item)
धृतिः|dhṛtiḥ|dhṛti — fortitude, steadfastness (nom. sg. fem., list item)
शौचमद्रोहो|śaucam adrohaḥ|śauca — cleanliness, purity (nom. sg. neut., list item; simply joined with adrohaḥ, -m unaffected before the vowel);;a-droha — freedom from malice, freedom from the wish to injure (nom. sg. masc., list item; -aḥ before n-→-o)
नातिमानिता|na atimānitā|na — not (na+atimānitā→nātimānitā, a+a→ā);;ati-mānitā — excessive pride, arrogance (ati-māna 'excessive pride' + abstract suffix -tā; nātimānitā: 'freedom from excessive pride', nom. sg. fem., list item — note the deliberate contrast with verse 4's darpa, 'pride', among the demonic traits)
--
भवन्ति|bhavanti|bhū — to be, become (bhavanti: present 3rd pl., 'they redound to, they constitute'; the verb governing the whole list of verses 1-3 as its subject, and taking sampadam as an accusative of the result reached rather than an ordinary nominative complement — traditionally glossed 'these come to constitute')
संपदं|sampadam|sampad — an endowment, an inheritance (acc. sg. fem., the result-accusative object of bhavanti)
दैवीमभिजातस्य|daivīm abhijātasya|daivī — divine (fem. adj. of daiva; daivīm: acc. sg. fem., agreeing with sampadam; simply joined with abhijātasya, -m unaffected before the vowel);;abhi-jan — born to, born with a natural bent toward (abhijāta: past participle; abhijātasya: gen. sg. masc., 'of one born [with this nature]')
भारत|bhārata|Bhārata — descendant of Bharata, Arjuna (vocative)
#4
दम्भो|dambhaḥ|dambha — hypocrisy, deceit (nom. sg. masc., list item; -aḥ before d-→-o)
दर्पोऽभिमानश्च|darpaḥ abhimānaḥ ca|darpa — pride, insolence (nom. sg. masc., list item; -aḥ+a-→-o' with avagraha);;abhi-māna — self-conceit, excessive self-regard (nom. sg. masc., list item; -aḥ+c-→-aś c-);;ca — and (BORI reads darpo 'timānaś ca here — atimāna, 'excessive pride' — in place of the vulgate's darpo 'bhimānaś ca, abhimāna 'self-conceit'; see the note)
क्रोधः|krodhaḥ|krodha — anger (nom. sg. masc., list item)
पारुष्यमेव|pāruṣyam eva|pāruṣya — harshness, roughness (nom. sg. neut., list item; simply joined with eva, -m unaffected before the vowel);;eva — indeed, too
च|ca|ca — and
--
अज्ञानं|ajñānam|a-jñāna — ignorance (nom. sg. neut., list item)
चाभिजातस्य|ca abhijātasya|ca — and (ca+abhijātasya→cābhijātasya, a+a→ā);;abhi-jan — born to (abhijāta: past participle; abhijātasya: gen. sg. masc., 'of one born [with this nature]', as at verse 3)
पार्थ|pārtha|Pārtha — son of Pṛthā, Arjuna (vocative)
संपदमासुरीम्|sampadam āsurīm|sampad — endowment (sampadam: acc. sg. fem., result-accusative object, as at verse 3; simply joined with āsurīm);;āsurī — demonic (fem. adj. of āsura; āsurīm: acc. sg. fem., agreeing with sampadam)
#5
दैवी|daivī|daivī — divine (fem. adj., nom. sg., subject)
संपद्विमोक्षाय|sampat vimokṣāya|sampad — endowment (sampat: nom. sg. fem., subject; written together with the following word since both are voiced, no visible sandhi change);;vi-mokṣa — liberation, release (vimokṣāya: dat. sg., 'for liberation', purpose)
निबन्धायासुरी|nibandhāya āsurī|ni-bandha — bondage (nibandhāya: dat. sg., 'for bondage', purpose, paired with vimokṣāya);;āsurī — demonic (fem. adj., nom. sg., subject, second of the pair; nibandhāya+āsurī→nibandhāyāsurī, a+ā→ā)
मता|matā|man — thought, held to be, considered (mata: past participle of man; matā: nom. sg. fem., predicate, agreeing with both daivī and āsurī of this verse)
--
मा|mā|mā — do not (prohibitive particle, taking the following injunctive)
शुचः|śucaḥ|śuc — to grieve (śucaḥ: injunctive 2nd sg. with mā, 'do not grieve')
संपदं|sampadam|sampad — endowment (acc. sg. fem., object of asi understood loosely as 'born to'; as at verses 3-4)
दैवीमभिजातोऽसि|daivīm abhijātaḥ asi|daivī — divine (daivīm: acc. sg. fem., agreeing with sampadam; simply joined with abhijātaḥ);;abhi-jan — born to (abhijāta: past participle; abhijātaḥ: nom. sg. masc., predicate agreeing with 'you'; -aḥ+a-→-o' with avagraha);;as — to be (asi: present 2nd sg., 'you are')
पाण्डव|pāṇḍava|Pāṇḍava — son of Pāṇḍu, Arjuna (vocative)
#6
द्वौ|dvau|dvi — two (dvau: nom. dual masc.)
भूतसर्गौ|bhūta-sargau|bhūta — a being, a creature (first member);;sarga — creation, class, order (bhūta-sarga: 'classes of created beings', nom. dual masc., subject)
लोकेऽस्मिन्दैव|loke asmin daivaḥ|loka — world (loke: loc. sg.; loke+asmin→loke'smin, e+a→e with the a- elided, marked by avagraha);;idam — this (asmin: loc. sg. masc., 'in this');;daiva — divine (daivaḥ: nom. sg. masc., predicate, first of the pair; asmin+daivaḥ simply joined, the dental nasal unaffected before the following dental d-)
आसुर|āsuraḥ|āsura — demonic (nom. sg. masc., predicate, second of the pair; -aḥ+e-→-a e-, hiatus retained rather than fusing to -aiva, as at 15.16's akṣaraḥ eva — an accepted option in epic verse)
एव|eva|eva — indeed, too
च|ca|ca — and
--
दैवो|daivaḥ|daiva — the divine [kind] (nom. sg. masc., subject, resuming 6a's daivaḥ; -aḥ before v-→-o)
विस्तरशः|vistaraśaḥ|vistara — extension, fullness, detail (vistaraśaḥ: adverb, 'at length, in detail', formed with the adverbial suffix -śas)
प्रोक्त|proktaḥ|pra-vac — declared, described (prokta: past participle; proktaḥ: nom. sg. masc., predicate agreeing with daivaḥ, 'has been described'; final -ḥ dropped before the following vowel a-, hiatus retained as at 6a)
आसुरं|āsuram|āsura — the demonic [kind] (acc. sg. masc., object of śṛṇu, resuming bhūtasargau)
पार्थ|pārtha|Pārtha — Arjuna (vocative)
मे|me|aham — I (me: enclitic gen./abl. sg., 'from me')
शृणु|śṛṇu|śru — to hear (śṛṇu: imperative 2nd sg., 'hear!')
#7
प्रवृत्तिं|pravṛttim|pra-vṛt — right action, engagement, activity (acc. sg. fem., object of viduḥ)
च|ca|ca — and
निवृत्तिं|nivṛttim|ni-vṛt — cessation, withdrawal from action (acc. sg. fem., object of viduḥ)
च|ca|ca — and
जना|janāḥ|jana — a person, people (janāḥ: nom. pl. masc., subject; -āḥ before n-→-ā)
न|na|na — not
विदुरासुराः|viduḥ āsurāḥ|vid — to know (viduḥ: perfect 3rd pl. used as present, 'they know'; -uḥ+ā-→-ur ā-, the visarga after u becoming r before a voiced sound);;āsura — demonic (āsurāḥ: nom. pl. masc., subject, in apposition with janāḥ, 'demonic people')
--
न|na|na — not
शौचं|śaucam|śauca — purity, cleanliness (nom. sg. neut., subject)
नापि|na api|na — not (na+api→nāpi, a+a→ā);;api — also, even
चाचारो|ca ācāraḥ|ca — and (ca+ācāraḥ→cācāraḥ, a+ā→ā);;ā-car — right conduct, proper behavior (ācāraḥ: nom. sg. masc., subject; -aḥ before n-→-o)
न|na|na — not
सत्यं|satyam|satya — truth, truthfulness (nom. sg. neut., subject)
तेषु|teṣu|tad — in them (teṣu: loc. pl. masc., referring to the āsurāḥ of the first line)
विद्यते|vidyate|vid — to exist, be found (vidyate: present passive 3rd sg., 'is found')
#8
असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं|asatyam apratiṣṭham|a-satya — unreal, untrue (asatyam: acc. sg. neut., agreeing with jagat, first predicate; simply joined with apratiṣṭham);;a-pratiṣṭha — without foundation, groundless (apratiṣṭham: acc. sg. neut., agreeing with jagat, second predicate)
ते|te|tad — they (te: nom. pl. masc., subject, referring to the āsurāḥ of verse 7)
जगदाहुरनीश्वरम्|jagat āhuḥ anīśvaram|jagat — the world (acc. sg. neut., object of āhuḥ; jagat+āhuḥ→jagadāhuḥ, -t+ā-→-d ā-, a stop voiced before a vowel);;ā-ah — to say, declare (āhuḥ: perfect 3rd pl., 'they say'; -uḥ+a-→-ur a-, the visarga after u becoming r before a voiced sound);;an-īśvara — without a lord, without a god, godless (anīśvaram: acc. sg. neut., agreeing with jagat, third predicate)
--
अपरस्परसंभूतं|aparaspara-saṃbhūtam|aparaspara — one another, mutual(ly) (an old form synonymous with the more familiar paraspara, so glossed already by Śaṅkara — not the privative a- 'not', which would reverse the sense; first member);;sam-bhū — produced, arisen (saṃbhūta: past participle; aparaspara-saṃbhūtam: 'produced by mutual union', acc. sg. neut., predicate agreeing with jagat)
किमन्यत्कामहैतुकम्|kim anyat kāma-haitukam|kim — what? (interrogative, 'what else [could it be]');;anyat — other, else (nom./acc. sg. neut.);;kāma — desire (first member);;haituka — caused by, having as its cause (from hetu, 'cause'; kāma-haitukam: 'caused by desire alone', acc. sg. neut., predicate)
#9
एतां|etām|etad — this (etām: acc. sg. fem., object of avaṣṭabhya, 'this view')
दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य|dṛṣṭim avaṣṭabhya|dṛṣṭi — a view, an opinion, an outlook (acc. sg. fem., object of avaṣṭabhya; simply joined with avaṣṭabhya);;ava-stambh — to hold fast to, cling to, adopt (avaṣṭabhya: gerund, 'having taken hold of')
नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः|naṣṭa-ātmānaḥ alpa-buddhayaḥ|naṣṭa — lost, ruined (past participle of naś; first member);;ātman — self (naṣṭa-ātman: 'whose self is lost', bahuvrīhi, nom. pl. masc., subject; -aḥ+a-→-o' with avagraha);;alpa — little, small (first member);;buddhi — intelligence, understanding (alpa-buddhi: 'of little intelligence', bahuvrīhi, nom. pl. masc., in apposition)
--
प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः|prabhavanti ugra-karmāṇaḥ|pra-bhū — to arise, come forth (prabhavanti: present 3rd pl., 'they arise'; -i+u-→-y u-);;ugra — fierce, terrible (first member);;karman — deed, action (ugra-karman: 'of fierce deeds', bahuvrīhi, nom. pl. masc., in apposition)
क्षयाय|kṣayāya|kṣaya — destruction, ruin (dat. sg., purpose; jagataḥ below serves both kṣayāya and ahitāḥ, 'for the destruction of the world' and 'enemies of the world')
जगतोऽहिताः|jagataḥ ahitāḥ|jagat — world (jagataḥ: gen. sg.; -aḥ+a-→-o' with avagraha);;a-hita — hostile, harmful (ahitāḥ: nom. pl. masc., predicate, 'as enemies')
#10
काममाश्रित्य|kāmam āśritya|kāma — desire (acc. sg. masc., object of āśritya; simply joined with āśritya);;ā-śri — to resort to, give oneself over to (āśritya: gerund, 'having given themselves over to')
दुष्पूरं|duṣpūram|duṣ-pūra — hard to fill, insatiable (duṣ- 'ill, hard' + pūra 'filling'; acc. sg. masc., agreeing with kāmam)
दम्भमानमदान्विताः|dambha-māna-mada-anvitāḥ|dambha — hypocrisy (first member);;māna — pride, self-conceit (second member);;mada — arrogance (third member);;anvita — possessed by, filled with (from anu-i; dambha-māna-mada-anvitāḥ: 'filled with hypocrisy, pride and arrogance', nom. pl. masc., subject)
--
मोहाद्गृहीत्वासद्ग्राहान्प्रवर्तन्तेऽशुचिव्रताः|mohāt gṛhītvā asat-grāhān pravartante aśuci-vratāḥ|moha — delusion (mohāt: abl. sg., 'through delusion'; mohāt+gṛhītvā→mohādgṛhītvā, -t+g-→-d g-);;grah — to seize, adopt (gṛhītvā: gerund, 'having adopted'; gṛhītvā+asadgrāhān→gṛhītvāsadgrāhān, ā+a→ā);;a-sat — untrue, false (first member);;grāha — a notion, a tenet, a holding (asat-grāha: 'false notions', acc. pl. masc., object of gṛhītvā; -t+g-→-d g-);;pra-vṛt — to proceed, act (pravartante: present middle 3rd pl., 'they act'; grāhān+pravartante simply joined, the final -n unaffected before p-);;a-śuci — impure (first member);;vrata — a vow, a resolve, an observance (aśuci-vratāḥ: 'whose resolves are impure', bahuvrīhi, nom. pl. masc., subject; pravartante+aśucivratāḥ→pravartante'śucivratāḥ, -e+a-→-e' with avagraha) — the densest single-token sandhi run in this chapter: the whole second half-line is one written token
#11
चिन्तामपरिमेयां|cintām aparimeyām|cintā — anxiety, care, worry (acc. sg. fem., object of upāśritāḥ; simply joined with aparimeyām);;a-parimeya — immeasurable, unlimited (aparimeyām: acc. sg. fem., agreeing with cintām)
च|ca|ca — and
प्रलयान्तामुपाश्रिताः|pralaya-antām upāśritāḥ|pra-laya — dissolution, death (first member; pralaya+antām→pralayāntām, a+a→ā);;anta — end (pralaya-antām: 'ending [only] in death', acc. sg. fem., agreeing with cintām; simply joined with upāśritāḥ);;upa-ā-śri — beset by, given over to (upāśrita: past participle; upāśritāḥ: nom. pl. masc., subject)
--
कामोपभोगपरमा|kāma-upabhoga-paramāḥ|kāma — desire (first member);;upa-bhoga — enjoyment (second member; kāma+upabhoga→kāmopabhoga, a+u→o);;parama — highest, supreme (kāma-upabhoga-paramāḥ: 'holding sense-enjoyment as the highest goal', bahuvrīhi, nom. pl. masc., subject)
एतावदिति|etāvat iti|etāvat — this much, so much (nom. sg. neut., 'this is all [there is]');;iti — thus, [thinking] (quotation particle marking the preceding as a thought; etāvat+iti→etāvaditi, -t+i-→-d i-, a stop voiced before a vowel)
निश्चिताः|niścitāḥ|ni-ci — determined, certain, resolved (niścita: past participle; niścitāḥ: nom. pl. masc., predicate agreeing with the subject)
#12
आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः|āśā-pāśa-śataiḥ baddhāḥ|āśā — hope, expectation (first member);;pāśa — a tie, a bond, a snare (second member; āśā+pāśa→āśāpāśa);;śata — a hundred (āśā-pāśa-śataiḥ: 'by hundreds of ties of hope', instr. pl.; -aiḥ+b-→-air b-);;bandh — bound, tied (baddha: past participle; baddhāḥ: nom. pl. masc., subject, 'bound')
कामक्रोधपरायणाः|kāma-krodha-parāyaṇāḥ|kāma — desire (first member);;krodha — anger (second member);;parāyaṇa — intent on, given over to (kāma-krodha-parāyaṇāḥ: 'given over to desire and anger', bahuvrīhi, nom. pl. masc., in apposition)
--
ईहन्ते|īhante|īh — to strive, endeavor (īhante: present middle 3rd pl., 'they strive')
कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थसञ्चयान्|kāma-bhoga-artham anyāyena artha-sañcayān|kāma — desire (first member);;bhoga — enjoyment (second member; kāma+bhoga→kāmabhoga);;artha — purpose, sake (kāma-bhoga-artham: 'for the sake of gratifying desire', adverbial acc.; simply joined with anyāyena);;a-nyāya — injustice, wrong means (anyāyena: instr. sg., 'by unjust means'; anyāyena+arthasañcayān→anyāyenārthasañcayān, a+a→ā);;artha — wealth, riches (first member);;sañcaya — accumulation, amassing (artha-sañcayān: 'hoards of wealth', acc. pl. masc., object of īhante)
#13
इदमद्य|idam adya|idam — this (nom./acc. sg. neut., understood object, 'this [much]');;adya — today, now (adverb)
मया|mayā|aham — I (mayā: instr. sg., 'by me')
लब्धमिमं|labdham imam|labh — obtained, gained (labdha: past participle; labdham: nom. sg. neut., predicate, 'this has been gained');;idam — this (imam: acc. sg. masc., object of prāpsye, vulgate reading agreeing with manoratham, masc.; BORI reads idam, neuter, in its place — see the note)
प्राप्स्ये|prāpsye|āp — to obtain, gain (prāpsye: future middle 1st sg., 'I shall gain')
मनोरथम्|manoratham|manas — mind (first member);;ratha — chariot; manoratha 'mind's chariot', i.e. a wish, a desire (acc. sg. masc., object of prāpsye)
--
इदमस्तीदमपि|idam asti idam api|idam — this (nom. sg. neut., subject, 'this is [mine]');;as — to be (asti: present 3rd sg., 'is'; asti+idam→astīdam, i+i→ī);;idam — this (nom. sg. neut., subject, second clause; simply joined with api);;api — also, too
मे|me|aham — my (me: enclitic gen. sg.)
भविष्यति|bhaviṣyati|bhū — to be, become (bhaviṣyati: future 3rd sg., 'will be')
पुनर्धनम्|punaḥ dhanam|punar — again, further (punar: adverb; the basic form of this word before voiced sounds, with punaḥ its pausa form; punaḥ+dhanam→punardhanam);;dhana — wealth (nom. sg. neut., subject, 'this wealth too [shall be mine]')
#14
असौ|asau|adas — that (asau: nom. sg. masc., subject, 'that [enemy]')
मया|mayā|aham — by me (instr. sg.)
हतः|hataḥ|han — slain (hata: past participle; hataḥ: nom. sg. masc., predicate, 'has been slain')
शत्रुर्हनिष्ये|śatruḥ haniṣye|śatru — enemy (śatruḥ: nom. sg. masc., in apposition with asau; -uḥ+h-→-ur h-);;han — to slay (haniṣye: future middle 1st sg., 'I shall slay')
चापरानपि|ca aparān api|ca — and (ca+aparān→cāparān, a+a→ā);;a-para — other (aparān: acc. pl. masc., object of haniṣye; simply joined with api);;api — also, too
